newsitem.title: USA: Gilbert adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Gilbert adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Gilbert Associates Inc said Wednesday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan.
The company said it is committed to eliminating its "dual class of common stock structure."
Details of the plan were not immediately available.

Late on Wednesday, the company disclosed details of the plan, saying it would be triggered 10 days after an individual acquired 20 percent or more of the company's outstanding Class A common stock, or Class B common stock, or 15 percent or more of its outstanding shares of all classes of common stock.

Under the plan, the company will distribute one Series A right for for each outstanding share of the company's Class A common stock and one Series B right for each outstanding share of Class B common stock.
The distribution will be awarded to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 14.

Each right would entitle the holder to purchase 1/1000th of a share of either Series A Junior Participating Preferred Stock, or Series B Junior Participating Preferred Stock at a price of $60 per right.
